Thus exactly one solution t<=t*, three t>t*. Independent exact symbolic checks of factorization/discriminants/Bernstein negativity and direct cone-volume substitutions at three rational B values were successful. Fixed origin supports and no scaling/translation quotient; t=t* belongs to single-solution regime.
